{"inp":{"code":"# Calculations for EQTL3 based on provided data
price = 33.85
lpa = 1.666319
vpa = 17.523341
prev_target = 40.3

pl = price / lpa
pvp = price / vpa
upside = (prev_target - price) / price * 100
pl_target = prev_target / lpa
pvp_target = prev_target / vpa

support1 = 33.22
support2 = 32.7661
support3 = 32.755
res1 = 34.3415
res2 = 34.71
res3 = 35.9169

print(f"Preço atual: R${price:.2f}")
print(f"LPA: R${lpa:.6f}, VPA: R${vpa:.6f}")
print(f"P/L atual: {pl:.2f}x")
print(f"P/VP atual: {pvp:.2f}x")
print(f"Upside até R${prev_target:.2f}: {upside:.1f}%")
print(f"P/L no target R${prev_target:.2f}: {pl_target:.2f}x")
print(f"P/VP no target R${prev_target:.2f}: {pvp_target:.2f}x")
print('\nSuportes:')
print(support1, support2, support3)
print('Resistências:')
print(res1, res2, res3)

# downside to lower support
downside_to_lower = (price - support2) / price * 100
print(f"Possível queda até BB_lower {support2}: {downside_to_lower:.2f}%")

# generate a brief summary text
summary = (f"Preço atual R${price:.2f}. P/L~{pl:.2f}x; P/VP~{pvp:.2f}x. "
           f"Target de venda proposto R${prev_target:.2f} (horizonte 12 meses," 
           f" alavancagem e re-rating) => upside {upside:.1f}%.")
print('\n'+summary)

# print as JSON-like dict for assistant use
result = {
    'price': price,
    'lpa': lpa,
    'vpa': vpa,
    'pl': round(pl,2),
    'pvp': round(pvp,2),
    'target': prev_target,
    'upside_pct': round(upside,1),
    'pl_target': round(pl_target,2),
    'pvp_target': round(pvp_target,2),
    'support2': support2,
    'downside_to_support2_pct': round(downside_to_lower,2)
}
print('\nRESULT_DICT:')
print(result)"} }
